name: YEWLEE
recent: Yew Lee 近期多次因凭单转换为普通股而增加发行股本，同时董事 Datuk Ang Lee Leong 在闭门期内申报减持股份与凭单。公司也进行了股份回购。最新季度净利环比大幅下滑。
notable: 凭单转换为普通股，多次发行新股并上市。
董事 Datuk Ang Lee Leong 在闭门期内减持股份及凭单。
risks: 凭单转换导致股本逐步扩大。
董事在闭门期内减持股份与凭单。
earnings: 最新季度（2026-06-30）营收环比增1.3%，但净利环比降62.7%至RM527,000，净利率从29.8%降至11.0%；营收同比增5.8%，净利同比大幅增长。

recent_en: Yew Lee recently saw multiple increases in issued share capital from warrant conversions, while Director Datuk Ang Lee Leong reported disposals of shares and warrants during the closed period. The company also conducted share buybacks. Latest quarterly net profit fell sharply quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Warrants converted into ordinary shares, with multiple new share issuances and listings.
Director Datuk Ang Lee Leong disposed of shares and warrants during the closed period.
risks_en: Warrant conversions are gradually enlarging the share base.
Director disposed of shares and warrants during the closed period.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue rose 1.3% QoQ, but net profit fell 62.7% QoQ to RM527,000, with net margin down from 29.8% to 11.0%; revenue grew 5.8% YoY and net profit increased substantially YoY.
